Description
There are many different valuable
Canadian gold coins
that you can purchase, and one of the most famous and balanced of these coins is the .25 ounce gold coin. These 1/4 oz gold maple leaf coins are considered balanced because they carry a fair amount of gold in each coin without the overwhelming price that some people would normally associate with gold. Just about anyone with a few hundred dollars of personal wealth can make a healthy investment in gold coins. These coins are fairly common, meaning that individuals at BulliontradingLLC.com can get you just about as many as you need.
Overall, these maple gold coins are perfect for collections and investments alike, making them important foundations for any gold investment plan.
Design of Canadian Gold Maple Leaf 1/4 oz Coin
An effigy of Queen Elizabeth II is found on the obverse of every 1/4 oz Canadian Gold Maple Leaf Coins. Based on the year they were issued the image depicting Queen Elizabeth II, the right-center position could be different. From 1979 to 1989, the design was dominated by a portrait by Arnold Machin. The design was replaced in the years 1990-2003 by Dora de Pedery Huts depiction. Today, coins made after 2004 feature Susanna Blints’ design.
The reverse of the 1/10 OZ Canadian Maple Leaf Gold Coins will show the image of an individual, huge, and highly detailed Sugar Maple Leaf. The illustration of the sugar maple Leaf is a representation of its natural lines as well as striations in these maple leaves. It is surrounded on both sides by inscribed words Canada, Fine Gold 1/10 oz Or Pur. Walter Ott designed the design for the first issue in 1979.
Main Highlights of Canadian Gold Maple Leaf Coin 1/4 oz
Includes 1/4 troy oz .9999 Pure gold.
Produced by Royal Canadian Mint.
Every Gold coin is protected by packaging.
Ineligible to apply for Precious Metallic IRAs.
It has a face value of 10 Canadian Dollars.
It features a portrait of her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II on the obverse.
The illustration depicts a single, large Maple Leaf.
